summary: Spawned in the Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG across Level 0, The Hub, the Bonus mall and authored destinations. Character progression, inventory and appearance persist in player.state while Solo and Multiplayer keep separate mode/run state; a fresh player enters through intake, the solo laundromat opening and tutorial. Level ! is a solo ephemeral chase finale built from a place sim and shared chase, dressing and cutscene helpers.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes and anomalies; the Bonus Rooms door is north of the waking point in x0z0.
places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall, homes, atlas Teleport Station, interactive props and creator/body fixtures; a dressed glass-side Level 0 hall returns to the Lobby.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads and Camp Amber; sim/helpers compose doors, destinations, crews and local interactions.
places/intake (3D) - character creator/salon; fresh-player route visits here before its intro and tutorial.
places/laundromat (3D; solo, ephemeral) - at-2-am opening room staged by scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js before crossing to tutorial0.
places/tutorial0 (3D; solo, ephemeral) - staged office/corridor tutorial; sim dresses supplies and drawings and places physical-looking placards, stencils, maker plate and hand-scratched warning.
places/levelrun (3D; solo, ephemeral) - Level !, Run for Your Life!: 416 m hospital chase, mid-run blackout, hazards, pursuers, intro/retry/rescue cuts and Safe Alcove.

places/level1, level1c, level2, level21, level26, level4, level5, level9, level10, level11, level12, level61, level70, level132, level169, level178 and other places/* - authored and procedural destinations; Level 11 connects into Level ! and its Safe Alcove route continues to Level 109.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera and ordered player behavior/actions; locomotion, interaction, combat, inventory, social, quests and other systems attach here.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js - per-player arrival, fresh-character and mode/run routing; main-menu-ui.js renders title/pause and expedition settings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, static placements and generation/tick behavior; sims also run environmental and sign/surface passes.
places/levelrun/config.yaml + places/levelrun/sim.js - solo ephemeral Level ! room dressing, chase orchestration, hazards, rescue and exit; shared helpers own its mechanics and cuts.

scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js + scripts/lib/levelrun-dress.js + scripts/lib/levelrun-cut.js - shared Level ! dimensions/obstacles and pursuit rules, room dressing, and player-side cutscene lifecycle.
places/level169, level132, level178 configs/sims + terrain scripts and local helpers - seeded terrain and authored setpieces, town schedules/barter, Kyoto residents and house quest.
places/laundromat/config.yaml + cells/x0z0.scene; scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js - local opening/cutscene behavior and handoff to tutorial0.
places/tutorial0/sim.js + scripts/lib/tutorial.js + scripts/tutorial-ui.js - tutorial room dressing, position/state-based prompts, and reusable Field Guide rendering.
shared: scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js - Level ! corridor, obstacle table, Agility profile, obstacle contact and horde pursuit; reused by its sim, scripts/player.js and tests.
scripts/lib/levelrun-dress.js - common modular hospital room dressing and model table reused by places/levelrun/sim.js and Level 109 setpieces.
scripts/lib/levelrun-cut.js - intro, retry, blackout-midpoint and rescue cut lifecycle/UI shared between main-menu, cutscene-ui and Level ! sim.
scripts/lib/survival.js - needs-aware stamina recovery multiplier and status label; player.js uses the multiplier and craft-ui.js displays the status.
scripts/lib/places.js - canonical place names/labels/HUD titles and valid atlas destinations; consumed by feed, quests and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js + scripts/lib/cat-wardrobe.js + wardrobe/face data - shared player/NPC cat bodies, outfits, hair, face and eye rendering; NPC face variety is seeded.
scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js + scripts/lib/mp-guard.js - hub routing/keys and multiplayer-room detection, NPC nonlethal down rule and solo death handling.
notableExports: scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js - CORRIDOR, OBSTACLES, agilityProfile, hitObstacle, stepHordeZ.
scripts/lib/levelrun-cut.js - LRUN_INTRO_LEN, LRUN_AGAIN_LEN, LRUN_MID_LEN, LRUN_RESCUE_LEN, startIntroCut, startRescueCut, finishRescueToAlcove, lrunCutTick, lrunUi.
scripts/bonus-l0-geo.js - geometry; scripts/bonus-l0-exit.js - onTriggerEnter; scripts/lrun-adrenaline.js - onTriggerEnter.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; places/level10/sim.js and places/level21/sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/lib/tutorial.js - inOrientation, GUIDE_CHAPTERS, orientation, GUIDE_LESSONS, tipsMuted, currentTip, guideTick, guideInput; scripts/tutorial-ui.js - tutUi, fieldGuideUi.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable character player.state: progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance, currency and gear shared across Solo/Multiplayer.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates progression; modifiers, clothes and manuals data/scripts own effects and learned recipes.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - mode/run picks; run/quest/story/resume keys swap per mode through SQL slots 91/92 while character and gear remain player.state.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - named save-slot snapshots and hidden Solo/Multiplayer mode snapshots; live character state remains player.state.
scripts/main-menu.js writes solo run.needs/run.sanity survival switches; scripts/player.js applies sanity and need drains and scales stamina recovery through scripts/lib/survival.js.
scripts/lib/hub.js noteAtlas, called by scripts/player.js on arrival - player.state.atlas first-seen dates/visit counts; place sims own local texV/signTexV completion stamps.
scripts/quest-prop-use.js and level quest layers own player.state clue/quest flags; Level 325 owns l325 salvage/scrap progress; page IDs and current reading are player.state.pages/reading.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js + scripts/lib/tutorial.js - opening/tutorial progress in player.state; cut timing and camera/light/sound staging are session/cutscene state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered player behavior stack for locomotion, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV, radio, barter and phone; scripts/interact.js dispatches focused interactions.
scripts/fall-guard.js holds velocity across place changes for ground streaming; grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; player.js builds viewmodel/avatar through critter-model appearance builders.
Fresh player detected in scripts/main-menu.js → intake/creator then solo laundromat; scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js plays the opening and crosses to tutorial0.

places/tutorial0/sim.js tick → dresses the room, supplies and in-world signs; scripts/lib/tutorial.js orientation and guideTick read place/position/player state → tutorial-ui.js and Field Guide prompts.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on arrival.
scripts/main-menu-ui.js title/pause actions → scripts/main-menu.js, which routes starts/mode picks and applies solo needs/sanity switches.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js mpRoom/toSolo → party room mp-<party> or personal room; scripts/bonus-door.js → hub.toHub; the Bonus glass hall's scripts/bonus-l0-exit.js sets bonusBack and routes toSolo(main), then main-menu places the player outside the Bonus door.

Level 11 door handler scripts/l11-ch2-drop.js → levelrun#lrun-start or #lrun-alcove; places/levelrun/sim.js dresses the run, advances horde and hazards and handles rescue/exit; Level ! exit returns to Level 11.

places/levelrun/sim.js proximity trigger → scripts/lrun-adrenaline.js adds stim_shot to player.state.snacks; player uses the item to apply med_stim → scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js agilityProfile boosts speed and sprint efficiency during the chase.
scripts/main-menu.js loads scripts/lib/levelrun-cut.js lrunCutTick → Level ! intro/retry/midpoint/rescue cuts and Safe Alcove handoff; cutscene-ui.js renders lrunUi.
scripts/lib/survival.js staminaFromNeeds(player.state) → scripts/player.js stamina regeneration; needsStatus(player.state) → scripts/craft-ui.js status display.

scripts/lib/mp-guard.js multiRoom/soloPlace → scripts/player.js damage and scripts/meg-agent.js death handling: multiplayer friendly NPCs are downed and recover; solo NPC deaths persist and quest deadCheck may fail tied quests.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes table and fitted chairs with paired orientations.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + ballistics.js + knock.js + loot.js - weapon variants share combat and rarity/level gates; weights and upgrade rolls vary by level; two-handed models/grips vary through weapon tuning and viewmodel pose.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.
scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.
scripts/lib/sleep.js + scripts/interact.js + scripts/rest.js + scripts/l178-prop.js - common bed detection/entry, with ordinary rest and Kyoto futon crossing as distinct outcomes.
scripts/lib/l169-road.js + l169-road-geo.js + l169-travel.js + l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.

places/levelrun/sim.js + scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js - one obstacle/hazard corridor family varies by position, hazard period and obstacle kind; pursuers join at depth marks and lights change at the midpoint.

places/level132/sim.js + l132-{stalls,shops,land,people,duke,quests,barter}.js + barter-deal.js - staged town and keeper trades use eight goods categories; first gift then balanced currency-free barter.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists; Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Solo and Multiplayer share one character but not run/story state: scripts/lib/run-opts.js isStoryKey defines the swapped key family; MODE_SLOT 91/92 are separate SQL snapshots and hidden from ordinary Save Manager slots.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js noStory() currently returns true in every mode; main-menu sweeps inherited main quest rows from quests/qtrack, and quests.setQuest refuses main rows. Side quests remain separate.

Fresh-player opening chain is main-menu → intake → laundromat → tutorial0; lmDone/arrivePending are player.state flags, while lmSkip and cut timing are session state. These opening places are solo/ephemeral.

Level ! uses places/levelrun/config.yaml solo/ephemeral; CORRIDOR and its 26 m chunk/door generation come from scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js. Keep sim geometry, hazard/pursuit depth marks, midZ blackout, collapseZ and exitZ aligned when changing run length.
The Level ! cart grants one stim_shot in the player's snacks; it is used from the bag and its med_stim effect is what mechanics.js checks. The level is intentionally excluded from atlas tracking.

Level 0 Bonus glass return sets player.state.bonusBack before toSolo(main); main-menu consumes it to position the player outside the Bonus door at (6.3, -5.2), facing the Lobby. Keep the hall trigger and this return placement coordinated.
